title: Inherited AcceptDialog with Children Scenes Give "Invalid new child index" Error
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in 4.5 and 4.5.1 stable
-Not reproducible in 4.4 stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7283) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 threads) - 31.78 GiB memory

### Issue description

Having an AcceptDialog with a child in an inherited scene gives the following error:

```
E 0:00:00:696   move_child: Invalid new child index: 2.
  <C++ Error>   Index p_index = 2 is out of bounds ((int)data.children_cache.size() + 1 - data.internal_children_front_count_cache - data.internal_children_back_count_cache = 2).
  <C++ Source>  scene/main/node.cpp:507 @ move_child()
```

 [Error C++ source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f62fdbde15035c5576dad93e586201f4d41ef0cb/scene/main/node.cpp#L507)

Taking a look at the scene source file we see that the index of the child is off, which is giving the error. The C++ source sees that it has an index of 2 when there are no other children in under the parent.

Child Scene code:

```[gd_scene load_steps=3 format=3 uid="uid://b1up18gebjvsj"]

[ext_resource type="PackedScene" uid="uid://cronmg4nxfja8" path="res://parent.tscn" id="1_vgl3u"]
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" uid="uid://d257ffddlidy4" path="res://icon.svg" id="2_d04bu"]

[node name="Child" instance=ExtResource("1_vgl3u")]

[node name="AcceptDialog" type="AcceptDialog" parent="." index="0"]
oversampling_override = 1.0
position = Vector2i(0, 36)
visible = true

[node name="Icon" type="Sprite2D" parent="AcceptDialog" index="2"]  <----- SHOULD BE ZERO
position = Vector2(265, 222)
texture = ExtResource("2_d04bu")
```


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Godot 4.5 project with a new empty Node Scene as the parent
2. Create a new instance child scene from the previously created parent node
3. Add AcceptDialog node to the child scene
4. Add any child node to the AcceptDialog
5. Run the child scene, note the error in the console

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23343340/test.zip)
